assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: hero art for a sophisticated Russian university student portal called Orbita. Create an architectural miniature still life, a meticulously constructed scale model of a contemporary university library: cream limestone monolithic stair terraces, a single rounded arch with translucent amber glass insert, one horizontal midnight-blue book-shaped volume, one small brushed aluminum sphere subtly tucked into an alcove. Art direction: collectible architectural object photographed in a premium design journal, physically believable miniature, crisp edge geometry, tactile limestone and milled aluminum, soft natural studio light from upper left. Warm ivory seamless background #f1eee7 with long subtle contact shadows, restrained electric cobalt detail, no green, no purple. Large model fills middle of a landscape 3:2 composition; plenty of clean ivory around it. Entire object visible. No text, no numbers, no UI, no logos, no watermark, no people, no floating objects, no generic cartoon graduation caps. This is an original generated asset, not a copy of an existing design.
assets.note: Imaginary architectural illustration, not a depiction of an actual REU building.
